scope: planned ligand family panel; focused fixed triad and all annotated source labels separately
source_expression: same IPF donor, >=50 cells in sender and receiver, each ligand/receptor subunit >=10% detection, >=3 donors for a fixed source label
target_statistics: NicheNet v2 prior Pearson; up/down donor DE separately; q<.05 and >=10 mapped genes
stability: full target-model refits with one donor removed, then source support rechecked; failed target/unit/source eligibility stays missing
not_retained_receptor: unevaluable with targeted extraction, not evidence of biological absence
interpretation: descriptive prioritization, not independent validation or causal mediation
